title: Lengths and incidences in Poisson hypersphere and spherical splitting tessellations
summary: We investigate distributional properties of two random tessellation models on the $d$-dimen\-sional unit sphere. First, we analyze the Poisson hypersphere tessellation generated by a Poisson process on the space of hyperspheres. We derive an explicit formula for the length distribution of its typical edge. Second, we turn to spherical splitting tessellations, which form a natural class of random tessellations driven by a geometry-dependent Markovian split dynamics.
